DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 最初のお飲み物はいかがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: What would you like for your first drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私は桃のアレルギーがあります。このフルーツソーダには桃が入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 桃アレルギーとミックス飲料の原料を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm allergic to peaches. Does this fruit soda contain peach?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Mention your peach allergy and ask about the ingredients in the mixed drink. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ミックスシロップに桃が入っています。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、それはやめます。シロップを使わない炭酸水はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 当該飲料をやめ無シロップの炭酸水を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I won't have that. Do you have sparkling water without syrup?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Decline that drink and ask for sparkling water without syrup. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、瓶入りの炭酸水があります。グラスにレモンを添えることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, we have bottled sparkling water. We can also serve it in a glass with lemon.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 瓶のままでお願いします。レモンも入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 瓶での提供とレモンなしを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please serve it in the bottle. No lemon either, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Specify that you want it in the bottle with no lemon. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: かしこまりました。開けてお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. Shall I open it before bringing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自分で開けたいので、未開封で持ってきてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分で開けるため未開封を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to open it myself. Could you bring it unopened?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for the bottle to be left unopened because you will open it yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。料理のアレルギーについても確認が必要でしたら、注文前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Of course. If you also need us to check food allergies, please let us know before ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今は飲み物だけにします。未開封の炭酸水を一本お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 料理は注文せず未開封炭酸水一本を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll just have a drink for now. One unopened bottle of sparkling water, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm one unopened bottle of sparkling water without ordering food. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-AMAGASAKI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please relax and enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学券はこちらで拝見します。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your admission ticket here.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: どうぞ。中で靴を脱ぐと聞きましたが、この革靴でも大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 革靴での入館方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here you are. I heard we have to remove our shoes inside. Are these leather shoes all right?
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to enter when wearing leather shoes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口で脱いで袋に入れ、ご自身で持っていただきます。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please take them off at the entrance, put them in a bag, and carry them yourself.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 靴が大きいので、この袋に入りそうにありません。大きな袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 靴の大きさに合う袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: My shoes are large, so I don't think they'll fit in this bag. Do you have a larger one?
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a bag that fits your shoes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。袋ごと手に持って見学できますか。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this one. Can you carry the bag with your shoes while looking around?

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、持てます。中を歩く時は靴下のままでいいですか。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯できると答え靴下で歩く可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I can. Is it all right to walk inside in my socks?
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can carry them and ask whether you may walk in your socks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 靴下でお進みいただけます。急な階段では手すりを使ってください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may walk in your socks. Please use the handrails on the steep stairs.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 片手を空けたいので、靴袋を自分のかばんに入れてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手すりを使うため靴袋をかばんへ入れたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to keep one hand free. May I put the shoe bag inside my own bag?
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to put the shoe bag in your bag so you can use the handrail. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かばんに収まるなら大丈夫です。荷物が階段に引っ掛からないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine if it fits. Please make sure your luggage doesn't catch on the stairs.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 収まりました。靴を脱いで、かばんを前に寄せて見学します。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収納できたことと入館時の荷物位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: It fits. I'll take my shoes off and keep my bag toward the front while looking around.
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the shoes fit in your bag and explain where you will position your bag when entering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-HYG-HIMEJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your visit. Watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示室のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about the exhibition room?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 絵をゆっくり見たいのですが、立っていると足が疲れます。座って見る場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 立ち疲れに対応する鑑賞用座席を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take my time looking at the paintings, but my legs get tired when I stand. Is there somewhere I can sit to look at them?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a seat for viewing the exhibits because standing makes you tired. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示室の中央にベンチがあります。折り畳み椅子も貸し出しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are benches in the middle of the exhibition room. We also lend out folding chairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 椅子を借りたいです。一つの絵の前で使ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貸出椅子を選び絵の前での使用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to borrow a chair. May I use it in front of a painting?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a loan chair and ask about using it in front of a painting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、ほかの方の通路を空けてご利用ください。移動時は畳んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please leave a clear passage for other visitors. Fold it when moving around.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 移動する時は畳みます。自分で持ち運べる重さか、試していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動時の扱いを確認し重さを試したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll fold it when moving. May I try lifting it to see whether I can carry it myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm how to handle it when moving, and ask to try its weight. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。開く時はこちらの部分を持ち、指を挟まないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Hold this part when opening it, and be careful not to pinch your fingers.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これなら持てます。見終わったら展示室に置いて帰ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち運べることを述べ返却場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can carry this. When I'm finished, should I just leave it in the exhibition room?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you can carry it and ask where to return it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の貸出カウンターへ戻してください。閉じた状態でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return it to the loan counter at the entrance, folded up.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。絵の前で通路を空けて使い、最後に入口へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路確保と返却方法をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see. I'll keep the passage clear when using it in front of a painting, and return it to the entrance at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize keeping the passage clear and how to return the chair. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり鑑賞なさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time and enjoy the paintings.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帽子をお試しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try on a hat?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この帽子は少し緩いです。一つ小さいサイズもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帽子の緩さを述べ小さいサイズを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This hat is a little loose. Do you also have one size smaller?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the hat is loose and ask for a smaller size. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらです。内側にも調整できるテープが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here it is. There's also an adjustable band inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい方は額がきついです。大きい方をテープで調整してみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小サイズのきつさを述べ大サイズの調整を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The smaller one is tight across my forehead. I'd like to try adjusting the larger one with the band.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the small size is tight and that you would like to adjust the larger size. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここを短くすると締まります。かぶり直してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shortening this part makes it tighter. Please try putting it on again.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ちょうどいいです。風で飛ばないように、あごひもを付けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調整の具合を伝えあごひもを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It fits just right. Can I attach a chin strap so it won't blow away in the wind?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe how the adjustment feels and ask for a chin strap. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 専用のひもをこちらに留められます。ひもは別売りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can fasten a matching strap here. The strap is sold separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ひももお願いします。普段は外して、かばんにしまえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別売りひもを選び着脱を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like the strap, too. Can I normally remove it and keep it in my bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the separately sold strap and ask about attaching and removing it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、両端の留め具を外せます。この状態でお渡ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the fasteners at both ends come off. Shall I give it to you like this?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 付けた状態でお願いします。帰りは風が強いので、ひもを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 装着状態で受け取り風の日に使うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please leave it attached. It's windy on my way home, so I'll use the strap.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to receive it with the strap attached and say that you will use it because it is windy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: うどんは何になさいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かけうどんを考えています。乳製品のアレルギーがあるので、つゆと麺の材料を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乳製品アレルギーと麺つゆの材料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm thinking of plain udon in broth. I have a dairy allergy, so I'd like to ask about the ingredients in the broth and noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your dairy allergy and ask about the ingredients in the noodles and broth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材料表をご覧いただけます。厨房は共用なので、混入しないとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can look at the ingredient list. We share the kitchen, so we can't promise there will be no cross-contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料表を見たいです。トレーにあるチーズの天ぷらは、ほかの天ぷらと同じ揚げ油ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 材料表の閲覧と天ぷらの揚げ油共用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to see the ingredient list. Is the cheese tempura on the tray fried in the same oil as the other tempura?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to see the ingredient list and whether the tempura shares frying oil. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ揚げ油です。具を取る前にご確認いただいてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It uses the same oil. It's good that you checked before picking up any toppings.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 天ぷらは取りません。今日は食べるか決める前に、材料表を写真に撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 天ぷらを避け判断前に材料表の撮影を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't take any tempura. Before deciding whether to eat here today, may I photograph the ingredient list?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid the tempura and ask to photograph the ingredient list before deciding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、材料表は撮影できます。料理の注文はまだ入れずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can photograph the ingredient list. I'll hold off on putting in a food order.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。列が進むので、横で表を見ても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未注文で列を外れ表を見る場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. The queue is moving. May I step aside and look at the list?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for somewhere to step out of the queue and read the list before ordering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの台でご覧ください。注文する場合は、見終わってからもう一度お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at it at this counter. If you decide to order, speak to us again after you've finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。トレーを戻して表を見ます。内容を確かめてから、注文するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: トレーを戻し材料確認後の注文判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see. I'll put the tray back and read the list. I'll decide whether to order after checking the ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return the tray and decide whether to order after checking the ingredients. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、どうぞご覧ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course, please take a look. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまで行かれますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の電車に乗りたいのですが、ホームを急いで歩くのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 急いでホームを歩けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take the next train, but it's difficult for me to walk quickly along the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you can't hurry along the platform. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次は二分後です。その次は十五分後になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The next train is in two minutes. The one after that is in fifteen minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次は見送ります。ホームへ行く前に座って待てる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 次列車を見送り座って待つ場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll let the next one go. Is there somewhere I can sit and wait before going to the platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to skip the next train and ask for somewhere to sit and wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 改札内の待合室が使えます。出発案内も中から見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use the waiting room inside the ticket gates. You can see the departure information from there, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで休みます。その次の電車も同じホームですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合室から次々列車のホームを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll rest there. Does the train after the next one use the same platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask from the waiting-room plan which platform the train after the next one uses. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、三番です。待合室を出て右の通路を進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, platform three. Leave the waiting room and follow the passage to the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三番ですね。五分前に待合室を出れば、ゆっくり歩いて間に合いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ゆっくり移動する出発タイミングを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Platform three, right? If I leave the waiting room five minutes before departure, do you think I can make it walking slowly?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask when to leave so you can walk slowly to the train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路はすぐ近くですが、歩く速さによります。余裕を見て少し早めにお出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The passage is very close, but it depends on how fast you walk. Please leave a little earlier to allow extra time.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。待合室で少し休んで、七分前には三番へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後に余裕を持ってホームへ向かうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see. I'll rest a little in the waiting room and head toward platform three at least seven minutes before departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will rest and then head to the platform with time to spare. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけて。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手続きのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越したので、運転免許証の住所を変えたいです。市役所の手続きとは別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 免許証の住所変更と市役所手続きの違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved and want to change the address on my driver's license. Is that separate from the city hall procedure?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how changing the address on your driver's license differs from city hall procedures. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、免許証の変更については担当窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. I'll direct you to the counter responsible for driver's license changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この建物でできるのですね。今の免許証だけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手持ちの免許証のみで来たと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I can do it in this building. I've only brought my current license.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you came with only your current driver's license. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい住所を確認できるものが必要か、担当が書類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the documents and whether you need something that verifies your new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新住所宛ての郵便は家にあります。今日は相談だけでもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所資料の所在を述べ事前相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have mail addressed to my new address at home. Can I just ask for advice today?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say where your proof of address is and ask for a preliminary consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、担当に持参書類を聞いていただけます。免許証はお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can ask the staff which documents to bring. Please keep your license with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当窓口は混んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 免許証を保持し待ち人数を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. Is the counter busy?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your license with you and ask how many people are waiting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は一組お待ちです。番号札を取ってお掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: One party is waiting at the moment. Please take a numbered ticket and have a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号札を取ります。今日は必要な書類を聞いて、そろえてから手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号札を取り必要資料の相談をする方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take a numbered ticket. Today I'll ask which documents are needed, and complete the procedure once I've gathered them.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take a numbered ticket and explain that you plan to ask about the required documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が順番にお呼びします。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff will call you in order. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明をいたします。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。この袋には朝夕とありますが、私は朝ご飯を食べないことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食を抜く生活と朝夕表示の不明点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. This bag says morning and evening, but I sometimes skip breakfast.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you sometimes skip breakfast and are unsure about the morning-and-evening instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲むタイミングは薬によって違います。処方内容を確認してお話ししますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The timing depends on the medication. I'll check the prescription and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。朝の分を昼にまとめて飲めばいいのか、迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服薬を昼にまとめる案の是非を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I'm not sure whether I should take the morning dose together with my other dose at lunchtime.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether it would be appropriate to combine your medication doses at lunchtime. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自己判断でまとめて飲まず、処方の指示に合う方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't combine doses on your own. Let's check how to take it in line with the prescription instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 普段は七時に起きて、食事は十一時です。どの時間を基準にすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 起床と食事時刻を述べ服用の基準を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I usually wake up at seven and eat at eleven. Which time should I use as the reference for taking it?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your waking and mealtime schedule and ask what to base the medication timing on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その生活時間を踏まえて薬剤師が個別にご説明します。ほかに飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The pharmacist will give you individual guidance based on that schedule. Are you taking any other medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 市販の胃薬があります。名前が分からないので、箱の写真を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 市販胃薬の箱写真による確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have an over-the-counter stomach medicine. I don't know its name. Could you look at a photo of the box?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to have an over-the-counter stomach medicine checked using a photo of its box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、写真を見せてください。分かる範囲を確認し、必要なら処方元にも照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please show me the photo. We'll check what we can and contact the prescriber if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この写真です。飲む時間と胃薬との併用を、確認してから使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真を提示し時間と併用の確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the photo. I'd like to confirm the timing and whether I can use it with the stomach medicine before taking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the photo and ask to confirm the timing and combined use of the medicines. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。処方内容と写真を確認します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll check the prescription and the photo. Please take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の書類を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me see the document you want to ask about.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。古い住所に届いた通知を、新しい家へ送ってもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所へ届いた通知を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. This notice arrived at my old address, and I had it sent to my new home.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the notice that arrived at your old address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転居されたのですね。封筒の宛名も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you've moved. Could you also show me the address on the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この宛名です。住所を変えたのに届いたので、同じ内容がもう一通来るのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名を示し二重通知への懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the address. It arrived even though I changed my address, so I'm worried another copy of the same notice might come.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the address label and express your concern about duplicate notices. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送時点の記録を担当が確認します。同じ通知かどうかは番号も照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the records as they stood when it was sent. They'll also compare the numbers to see whether it is the same notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい家にはまだ届いていません。この一通を払えばよいか、調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所で未着と述べ納付対象を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nothing has arrived at my new home yet. Could you check whether I should pay this one notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that nothing has arrived at your new address and ask which payment notice you should act on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に対象期間と納付状況を確認してもらいましょう。すでにお支払いになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's have the staff check the period it covers and the payment status. Have you already paid?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。期限が明日なので、今日中に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未納と翌日期限を伝え即日相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. The deadline is tomorrow, so I'd like to discuss it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you haven't paid and the deadline is tomorrow, and ask for a consultation today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その期限も伝えて引き継ぎます。本人確認書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on that deadline, too. Do you have identification with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。旧住所への通知と明日の期限について、担当に相談をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認書類を出し担当への引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, here it is. Please arrange for me to discuss the notice sent to my old address and tomorrow's deadline with the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide identification and ask for the matter to be handed over to the responsible staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当窓口へおつなぎします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-HIMEJI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll put you in touch with the responsible counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の確認にご協力ください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please cooperate with the bag check.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。水筒が入っています。中身をここで見せればいいですか。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水筒の内容確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Of course. There's a drink bottle inside. Should I show you the contents here?
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to have the contents of your drink bottle checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この入口では、ふたを開けて中をご確認させていただきます。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this entrance, we ask you to open the lid so we can check inside.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けます。お茶です。替えのふたも袋に入っています。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふたを開け中身と替えふたを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll open it. It's tea. There's also a spare lid in the bag.
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Open the lid and explain the contents and the spare lid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。その小さなケースには何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. What's in that small case?

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お弁当用の箸です。食べ物を入れた袋も出しましょうか。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小ケースの中身を話し食品袋も提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Chopsticks for my packed lunch. Shall I take out the bag with food in it, too?
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain what is in the small case and offer to show the food bag, too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、袋を開いて見せてください。確認後はご自身で戻していただけます。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please open the bag and show me. After the check, you can put it back yourself.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どうぞ。水筒は横にすると漏れるので、立てたまま入れ直します。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食品袋を開き水筒を立てて戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here you are. The drink bottle leaks if it's on its side, so I'll put it back upright.
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Open the food bag and say that you will put the drink bottle back upright. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。チケットは別の係へお見せください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's checked. Please show your ticket to a different staff member.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を戻しました。チケットを手に持って、次の係へ進みます。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を戻しチケット係へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put my things back. I'll hold my ticket in my hand and go to the next staff member.
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put your belongings back and proceed to the ticket staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。観戦をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy watching the game.
